clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within Razorfen Kraul, Agathelos the Raging is penned among the thorned tunnels. His great size matters to the quilboar, who revere Agamaggan as their god and progenitor, and rage makes the armored boar more fearsome still. His strength and mass make him one of the most dangerous beasts beneath the southern Barrens.

Agamaggan, a titanic boar, is the god and progenitor of the quilboar. Among the Razorfen tribes, a beast as large as Agathelos carries deep spiritual meaning. He stands roughly twice as tall as a Barrens thunder lizard.

The quilboar keep Agathelos from roaming freely through the Kraul. Several guards maintain a field in front of the short, dead-end tunnel where he is penned. Intruders who break through the barrier face a raging beast, made even bigger and more terrifying by his fury.
